description: Buyer-side costs of buying a property in Bulgaria — local transfer tax of the municipality, notary fee, VAT on the notary fee, registration fee, optional broker commission and additional (e.g. mortgage) costs — plus the total own funds needed: purchasePrice − loanAmount + total costs. Same calculation as the cost calculator on imotai.bg listings. Pass propertyId to use a listing's price and location, or purchasePrice with city/municipality. Values you pass are used for this calculation only; the listing is never changed. If the municipal rate is unknown, complete is false and ownFundsRequired is null — never guess a total. Excludes interest, monthly payments and seller costs. Show the "disclaimer" and any "warnings" to the user.

additionalCosts.description: Other buyer costs in EUR (bank valuation, bank fees, mortgage notary).

brokerCommissionPercent.description: Broker commission paid by the buyer, % of price.

brokerCommissionVatIncluded.description: true = add 20% VAT on top of the commission.

city.description: Settlement in Bulgarian, e.g. "Стара Загора", "Слънчев бряг".

loanAmount.description: Actual mortgage amount in EUR (0 or omitted = no loan). Not assumed to be 85%.

propertyId.description: ImotAI listing id (UUID) or URL slug.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in EUR; overrides the listing price for this calculation.

region.description: Province (област) — disambiguates settlements with the same name.

taxAssessment.description: Tax assessment (данъчна оценка) in EUR; if higher than the price, tax and fees use it.

name: calculate_transaction_costs
title: ImotAI purchase costs and own funds needed (Bulgaria)
